description: Loop Timing Witness provides hash-bound host analysis, native C/Rust/RTL controllers and RTL/RISC-V simulation for hardware-timestamped real-time control-loop events. Physical evidence remains architecture_only: the PolarFire SoC board instrument is unqualified and no measured hardware performance result is claimed. Source release0.1.0 archives the verified repository snapshot, including subsequent documentation and verification. Immutable Python/Rust registry0.1.0 distributions were originally published from commit4cffb60f176e8fb5037770ccdaee863f6aa758c9; package implementations are unchanged and their artifact provenance is recorded separately.
title: Loop Timing Witness
